program.section_heading: Create Space: Wood Shop, Noncredit Certificate of Completion
outcomes: operate a range of woodworking tools and machinery with proficiency.
Apply various woodworking techniques to achieve precise and high-quality results.
Select and handle different types of wood and materials appropriately.
Read and interpret woodworking plans and blueprints for accurate project execution.
Implement safety protocols to ensure a safe working environment.
Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on woodworking tools.
Apply finishing techniques to enhance the appearance and durability of wood projects.
Manage woodworking projects from initial design to final completion.

notes: Noncredit certificate; the catalog prints '(0 units)' for the Area of Emphasis and each course and states no hours, so measure is recorded as units and total_units as the printed 0.
The section's course list continues across the page break (page 95 to 96); the Area of Emphasis and Required Core Courses lines on page 96 were read as belonging to the Wood Shop section.
Outcomes are printed as a run-in paragraph after the lead-in 'students will be able to:'; each sentence was recorded as one outcome, keeping the lowercase 'operate' as printed.
Career entry 'woodworking' is taken from 'preparing students for various roles in woodworking and related industries'; reviewer may prefer a different reading or none.
